payload.name: Extract paired stressor and cheer source
payload.description: When a message pairs a stressor/difficulty with a cheer or joy source, extract both during construction; do not drop the positive reliance fact.
content: When extracting from a message that pairs a negative situation with a statement about what cheers the speaker up or brings joy, create a separate candidate for the positive reliance fact in addition to any candidate about the negative situation.

For each positive-cheer clause, persist the subject, the source of cheer, and the emotional effect (e.g., cheers up, brings joy, makes happy) as a profile or preference memory, not only within an event memory about the stressful context.

solves: When a construction candidate is generated from a message pairing a stated stressor with a clause about something that cheers the speaker up or brings joy, extraction often keeps only the stressor and drops the positive reliance fact. This skill applies during extraction to such paired messages, requiring a separate memory for the source of cheer. It does not apply to messages that only describe stress or only express enjoyment.
